observations.method: Get-ManagedSolverProcessSample: sum of max(WorkingSet64, PrivateMemorySize64) for complete pwsh and Python/native child trees
observations.limits: Single sampled runs, not proven worst-case bounds. Ruff consumers restrict RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1; only these named pure checks are classified. Larger or unknown stages remain exclusive.

rationale.snapshot_backoff: Rejected stale snapshots are resampled after bounded randomized backoff, without a retry-count failure. The five-second delay ceiling preserves cancellation and reduces synchronized contention; invalid telemetry still fails closed.
rationale.io_slots: One uncalibrated streaming I/O producer at a time; zero means metadata-only or no bulk I/O, not unrestricted disk access.
rationale.maximum_queue_bypasses: Bounded backfilling: after eight later admissions the older request becomes a queue barrier until it can run.
rationale.measured-small-check: Initial complete-tree observed envelopes with fourfold margin rounded upward to 64 MiB; not OS-enforced limits.
rationale.safety_reserves: Moved unchanged from the existing SIMION repository policy: 95 percent system CPU ceiling and 1 GiB physical-memory reserve. SIMION imports these same values.
rationale.mrtof_stages: Initial separate stage boundaries remain unknown/exclusive pending complete process-tree peak measurements. PA file-set bytes are not a process-memory peak. Publication includes retention and payload hashing, so it is not classified as zero bulk I/O. The campaign itself does not retain a grant between rows.
